double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point       \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n Cell size is >= threshold, so every point\n// within distance < threshold of a point lies in the 3x3 cell neighborhood.\nstruct Grid {\n    int ncx = 1, ncy = 1;\n    double csx = MAX_WIDTH, csy = MAX_HEIGHT;\n    std::vector<int> cell_start;  // CSR offsets, size ncx*ncy+1\n    std::vector<int> cell_pts;    // point indices grouped by cell\n    std::vector<int> cell_of;     // cell index of each point\n\n    void build(const std::vector<Point>& points, const double threshold) {\n        const double t = threshold * (1.0 + 1e-9);\n        ncx = static_cast<int>(std::min(2048.0, std::max(1.0, std::floor(MAX_WIDTH / t))));\n        ncy = static_cast<int>(std::min(2048.0, std::max(1.0, std::floor(MAX_HEIGHT / t))));\n        csx = MAX_WIDTH / ncx;\n        csy = MAX_HEIGHT / ncy;\n        const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n        cell_of.resize(N);\n        cell_start.assign(static_cast<size_t>(ncx) * ncy + 1, 0);\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            int cx = static_cast<int>(points[i].x / csx);\n            int cy = static_cast<int>(points[i].y / csy);\n            cx = std::min(std::max(cx, 0), ncx - 1);\n            cy = std::min(std::max(cy, 0), ncy - 1);\n            cell_of[i] = cy * ncx + cx;\n            cell_start[cell_of[i] + 1]++;\n        }\n        for (size_t c = 0; c + 1 < cell_start.size(); ++c) cell_start[c + 1] += cell_start[c];\n        cell_pts.resize(N);\n        std::vector<int> fill(cell_start.begin(), cell_start.end() - 1);\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) cell_pts[fill[cell_of[i]]++] = i;\n    }\n\n    // Call f(j) for every point j in the 3x3 cell neighborhood of point i\n    template <typename F>\n    inline void forNeighborhood(const int i, F&& f) const {\n        const int c = cell_of[i];\n        const int cx = c % ncx, cy = c / ncx;\n        const int y0 = std::max(cy - 1, 0), y1 = std::min(cy + 1, ncy - 1);\n        const int x0 = std::max(cx - 1, 0), x1 = std::min(cx + 1, ncx - 1);\n        for (int y = y0; y <= y1; ++y) {\n            const int b = cell_start[y * ncx + x0];\n            const int e = cell_start[y * ncx + x1 + 1];\n            for (int k = b; k < e; ++k) f(cell_pts[k]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// Scratch buffers for candidate cluster generation\nstruct Workspace {\n    std::vector<double> x, y, md;\n    std::vector<int> id;\n};\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point.\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster.\n//\n// Equivalent to repeatedly picking the unclustered point with the smallest\n// maximum distance to all current members (ties -> lowest index), subject to\n// that maximum being < threshold. The per-candidate maximum distance is kept\n// incrementally; once it reaches the threshold the candidate is dropped for\n// good, since the maximum can only grow.\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                             const std::vector<char>& clustered,\n                             const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                             const Grid& grid,\n                             const double threshold,\n                             Workspace& ws,\n                             std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    ws.x.clear(); ws.y.clear(); ws.md.clear(); ws.id.clear();\n    const Point sp = points[seed_point];\n    grid.forNeighborhood(seed_point, [&](int j) {\n        if (j == seed_point || clustered[j]) return;\n        const double d = distance(points[j], sp);\n        if (d < threshold) {\n            ws.x.push_back(points[j].x);\n            ws.y.push_back(points[j].y);\n            ws.md.push_back(d);\n            ws.id.push_back(j);\n        }\n    });\n\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        cluster_members->clear();\n        cluster_members->push_back(seed_point);\n    }\n\n    double* __restrict cx = ws.x.data();\n    double* __restrict cy = ws.y.data();\n    double* __restrict cmd = ws.md.data();\n    int* __restrict cid = ws.id.data();\n    int n = static_cast<int>(ws.id.size());\n    int size = 1;\n\n    // Initial selection: closest candidate to the seed\n    int best = -1;\n    {\n        double bd = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        int bi = std::numeric_limits<int>::max();\n        for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n            const double m = cmd[k];\n            if (m < bd || (m == bd && cid[k] < bi)) { bd = m; bi = cid[k]; best = k; }\n        }\n    }\n\n    while (best >= 0) {\n        // Add chosen candidate to the cluster\n        const Point np = {cx[best], cy[best]};\n        if (cluster_members) cluster_members->push_back(cid[best]);\n        ++size;\n        --n;\n        cx[best] = cx[n]; cy[best] = cy[n]; cmd[best] = cmd[n]; cid[best] = cid[n];\n\n        // Update max distances, drop candidates beyond threshold, pick next\n        best = -1;\n        double bd = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        int bi = std::numeric_limits<int>::max();\n        int w = 0;\n        for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n            const Point cp = {cx[k], cy[k]};\n            const double d = distance(cp, np);\n            const double m = std::max(cmd[k], d);\n            if (m < threshold) {\n                const int id = cid[k];\n                cx[w] = cp.x; cy[w] = cp.y; cmd[w] = m; cid[w] = id;\n                if (m < bd || (m == bd && id < bi)) { bd = m; bi = id; best = w; }\n                ++w;\n            }\n        }\n        n = w;\n    }\n    return size;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (MPI-parallel)\n//\n// Every rank holds the full point set and identical bookkeeping. Each seed has\n// a cached value that is either its exact candidate-cluster cardinality or an\n// upper bound (1 + number of unclustered points within threshold). r < nprocs; ++r) {\n            const long long b = static_cast<long long>(N) * r / nprocs;\n            const long long e = static_cast<long long>(N) * (r + 1) / nprocs;\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(b);\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>(e - b);\n        }\n        const int b = displs[rank], e = b + counts[rank];\n        for (int i = b; i < e; ++i) {\n            const Point pi = points[i];\n            int c = 0;\n            grid.forNeighborhood(i, [&](int j) {\n                if (j != i && distance(points[j], pi) < threshold) ++c;\n            });\n            nbcount[i] = c;\n        }\n        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, nbcount.data(),\n                       counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<int> value(N), version(N, 0);\n    std::vector<char> exact(N, 0);\n    struct Entry { int val; int idx; int ver; };\n    auto cmp = [](const Entry& a, const Entry& b) {\n        // max-heap on (val desc, idx asc)\n        return a.val < b.val || (a.val == b.val && a.idx > b.idx);\n    };\n    std::vector<Entry> heap;\n    heap.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(N) * 2);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        value[i] = 1 + nbcount[i];\n        heap.push_back({value[i], i, 0});\n    }\n    std::make_heap(heap.begin(), heap.end(), cmp);\n\n    auto popValid = [&](Entry& out) -> bool {\n        while (!heap.empty()) {\n            std::pop_heap(heap.begin(), heap.end(), cmp);\n            const Entry e = heap.back();\n            heap.pop_back();\n            if (!clustered[e.idx] && e.ver == version[e.idx]) { out = e; return true; }\n        }\n        return false;\n    };\n    auto pushEntry = [&](int idx) {\n        heap.push_back({value[idx], idx, version[idx]});\n        std::push_heap(heap.begin(), heap.end(), cmp);\n    };\n\n    std::vector<int> batch, results, members;\n    int remaining = N;\n\n    while (remaining > 0) {\n        int winner = -1;\n        int batch_mult = 1;\n        while (winner < 0) {\n            const size_t M = static_cast<size_t>(nprocs) * batch_mult;\n            batch.clear();\n            Entry e;\n            while (batch.size() < M && popValid(e)) {\n                if (exact[e.idx]) {\n                    if (batch.empty()) winner = e.idx;\n                    else heap.push_back(e), std::push_heap(heap.begin(), heap.end(), cmp);\n                    break;\n                }\n                batch.push_back(e.idx);\n            }\n            if (winner >= 0 || batch.empty()) break;\n\n            // Evaluate batch cyclically across ranks\n            results.assign(batch.size(), 0);\n            for (size_t k = rank; k < batch.size(); k += nprocs) {\n                results[k] = generateCandidateCluster(batch[k], clustered, points, grid,\n                                                      threshold, ws);\n            }\n            if (nprocs > 1) {\n                MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, results.data(), static_cast<int>(results.size()),\n                              MPI_INT, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            }\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < batch.size(); ++k) {\n                const int s = batch[k];\n                value[s] = results[k];\n                exact[s] = 1;\n                ++version[s];\n                pushEntry(s);\n            }\n            batch_mult = std::min(batch_mult * 2, 16);\n        }\n        if (winner < 0) break; // No more clusters can be formed\n\n        // Build the winning cluster (identically on all ranks)\n        generateCandidateCluster(winner, clustered, points, grid, threshold, ws, &members);\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = winner;\n        cluster.members = members;\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n\n        for (const int m : members) clustered[m] = 1;\n        remaining -= static_cast<int>(members.size());\n\n        // Invalidate seeds whose candidate set changed\n        for (const int q : members) {\n            const Point pq = points[q];\n            grid.forNeighborhood(q, [&](int s) {\n                if (clustered[s]) return;\n                if (distance(points[s], pq) < threshold) {\n                    --nbcount[s];\n                    exact[s] = 0;\n                    version[s] = -1; \n    // Perform QT clustering\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold);\n    \n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n    \n    if (!root) {\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Clustering max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n    }\n    \n    const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 : \n        static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n    \n    printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\", \n           total_clustered, num_points, \n           100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n    printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n    printf(\"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n    \n    // Performance metrics\n    const double time_sec = cluster_time.count() / 1000.0;\n    const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n    const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\\n\", \n           clusters_per_sec, points_per_sec);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        // Serialize cluster membership for hashing\n        std::vector<double> membershipData;\n        membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n        std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < membershipData.push_back(static_cast<double>(m));\n        }\n        print_results(membershipData, \"ClusterMembership\");\n    }\n    \n    int rc = 0;\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        const bool valid = validateClusters(clusters, points, threshold);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            rc = 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    fflush(stdout);\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return rc;\n}\n'''\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nEOF\ncat > CMakeLists.txt grid.forNeighborhood(i, [&](int j) {\n                if (j != i && distance(points[j], pi) < threshold) ++c;\n            });\n            nbcount[i] = c;\n        }\n dynamic load balancing\n    long* counter = nullptr;\n    MPI_Win win;\n    MPI_Win_allocate(rank == 0 ? sizeof(long) : 0, sizeof(long), MPI_INFO_NULL,\n                     MPI_COMM_WORLD, &counter, }\n        const int b = displs[rank], e = b + counts[rank];\n        for (int i = b; i < e; ++i) {\n            const Point pi = points[i];\n            int c = 0;\n            grid.forNeighborhood(i, [&](int j) {\n                if (j != i && distance(points[j], pi) < threshold) ++c;\n            });\n            nbcount[i] = c;\n        }\n        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, nbcount.data(),\n                       counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n\n    // Shared work counter on rank 0 for dynamic load balancing\n    long* counter = nullptr;\n    MPI_Win win;\n    MPI_Win_allocate(rank == 0 ? sizeof(long) : 0, sizeof(long), MPI_INFO_NULL,\n                     MPI_COMM_WORLD, &counter, {\n        // max-heap on (val desc, idx asc)\n        return a.val < b.val || (a.val == b.val && a.idx > b.idx);\n    };\n    std::vector<Entry> heap;\n    heap.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(N) * 2);\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CffpfsMhNCPTjn41RZxJC","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've parallelized `qtclustering` with MPI, and it now always runs under MPI. Its output is identical to the original's in every comparison I ran. Only `qtclustering.cpp` and `CMakeLists.txt` were changed, and the executable name is unchanged.\n\n**Correctness:** the original and new versions produce the same ClusterMembership hash for N from 40 to 3000 and thresholds from 0.05 to 30, on 1, 3, 4 and 8 ranks, and `-v` validation passes. Larger runs (N = 20k, 50k, 100k) give the same hash on every rank count, but I couldn't compare those against the original because it is far too slow there.\n\n**Performance:**\n\n| Case | Time |\n|---|---|\n| N=1000, original | 7024 ms |\n| N=1000, new, 4 ranks | 4 ms |\n| N=3000, new, 1 rank | 66 ms (same hash as the original) |\n| N=50000, new, 1 rank | 86 s |\n| N=50000, 16 / 64 / 128 ranks | 5.9 s / 2.0 s / 1.44 s (14.6× / 43× / 60×) |\n| N=100000, 32 / 128 / 256 ranks | 22.0 s / 6.9 s / 7.7 s |\n\nOn this machine (2×64-core EPYC) scaling flattens past 128 ranks; 256 ranks was slower than 128.\n\n**What changed:**\n- **Faster single-process algorithm, same results:**\n  - A spatial grid limits each seed to points within the threshold.\n  - Each candidate's distance to the cluster is updated incrementally instead of recomputed.\n  - The inner loop uses AVX, with a plain fallback when AVX isn't available.\n  - Distance arithmetic is ordered exactly as in the original binary, so results don't drift.\n  - Seeds are only fully evaluated when they could actually win the round; ties still go to the lowest index, as in the original.\n  - After each cluster forms, only seeds whose result could have changed are re-evaluated.\n- **MPI parallelization:**\n  - Every rank holds the full data and identical state.\n  - Seed evaluations are shared out dynamically through an MPI one-sided atomic counter and combined with `MPI_Allreduce`.\n  - The winning cluster is broadcast by the rank that computed it.\n  - The bookkeeping after each new cluster is also split across ranks.\n- **Output and build:** only rank 0 prints, and the timer starts and ends with a barrier. `CMakeLists.txt` uses `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and links `MPI::MPI_CXX`; there are no new dependencies beyond MPI itself.\n\n**Things to know:**\n- **Original hang for N < 30:** the original never finishes for fewer than 30 points, because its data generator loops forever. The new version keeps that generator unchanged, so it behaves the same way.\n- **Single-rank runs:** `mpirun -np 1` pins the process to core 0, which was busy on this shared machine and made single-rank runs about twice as slow (N=20000: 17.3 s vs 7.3 s). Use `--bind-to none` or run the binary directly for a fair 1-rank baseline; the 86 s figure above was measured that way.\n- **Memory:** each rank keeps up to about 64 MB of cached cluster member lists so it doesn't have to recompute the winning cluster.\n- **Cleanup:** I deleted the `build/` directory I used for testing, so the folder holds only the two original files."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":195,"cache_read_input_tokens":114175,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":195},"output_tokens":808,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"27260d6c-7a80-4cea-8a9c-9b62f9ed5999","uuid":"1e9f0c06-b71a-43a8-b793-7661b01adcb7","timestamp":"2026-10-03T19:03:19.665Z","request_id":"req_011CffpfrC1VCVf4MBKNcrWf"}
